implementation: Round 2 Returns Manager (Python): one batched Gemini vision call per unit reports observations only; deterministic checks (identity, completeness, condition on Amazon's published scale) and an ordered rule table decide the disposition. No photos or a model failure gives UNCERTAIN / pending_review, never a guess. Compares what came back with Pack's sealed contents when Pack evidence exists.
notes: In-process by default. Also serves GET /health and POST /run: uvicorn agents.returns.app:app --port 8104. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY in .env to inspect photos; without it every photographed unit fails open to a pending record.
